title: Curve-preserving InsetFacesNode with generated output
description: When input has bezier handles, compute inner-boundary vertices on the coons surface at [t,1-t] parameters; inner edges use de Casteljau sub-curve handles; radial bridge edges use Coons cross-section formula (reuse CoonsLoopCutNode.computeCrossHandles). Add 'generated' BOOLEAN output port - true on the inner face. Fallback to current lerp-toward-center behavior when no handles.
definition-of-done: 1. Inset with handles produces valid handle arrays. 2. generated output marks inner face. 3. Fallback works. 4. Inner boundary lies on the coons surface of the original face.
testing-plan: 1. cube->assign_bezier_handles->inset_faces->coons_patch: inner face smoothly depressed, no cheese grater. 2. Chain: inset_faces(selection=first_inset.generated) targets the inner face.
